dcterms:description: A dataset containing motion capture sequences used for hierarchical clustering of hidden Markov models (HMMs). The dataset includes various motion examples categorized into different classes such as 'jump', 'run', 'jog', 'walk', 'basket', and 'soccer'.
dcterms:title: Motion Capture Dataset

dcterms:creator: E. Coviello
A. B. Chan
G. R. G. Lanckriet
dcterms:description: The CAL500 dataset consists of 502 songs annotated with respect to a vocabulary of 149 tags. It is used for automatic music tagging and includes audio features extracted from the songs.
dcterms:title: CAL500 Dataset
